correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=2, F_d is exactly the union of two natural cone-over-simplex-skeleton complexes with K_{a,b} one-skeleton intersection. Relative homology of their full simplex pieces is P_B tensor exterior^d U_A and P_A tensor exterior^d U_B. Natural integral Mayer–Vietoris proves the H_2 short exact sequence at d=2, the canonical surviving W lattice at d>=3, and the pure degree-d modules and death maps. F_0 and F_1 follow from a separate relative chain computation. All groups are free integral lattices. The independent finite enumerator checks all stages, three characteristics, standard rectangle cycles, and all side-preserving group permutations for five size pairs. Character computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The degree-bounded induced forest filtration of complete bipartite graphs is an intrinsically defined and published graph-topology benchmark. The result identifies exactly which homology classes at the same degree persist and which die, rather than only their Betti counts, and gives complete side-preserving rational characters plus integral lattice layers for all graph sizes and all filtration stages. The canonical free extension kernel at degree two and the exterior-power representation formulas provide structural information useful for distinguishing filtered inclusions and symmetries; this is not a renamed stagewise sphere count.
